title: A Compass for the Atlas
author: Casper Brightwater
blurb: Jude Galloway, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
